//TR: Bu checkpoint ilk target-machine Phase0 denemesinde bulunan üç hatanın Founder yetkili düzeltmesini, Founder'ın çalıştırdığı scratch kuru çalıştırma kanıtını ve düzeltmelerle aynı commit'teki yeni trust-root reseal'ini kaydeder; SHA256SUMS, ZIP, imza veya target-machine Phase0 yapıldığı iddiası değildir.

founderAuthorization.rule: Üç protected düzeltmeyi onaylıyorum. Builder policy acceptEdits değişikliği yalnızca çalışma dizini içindeki edit/write işlemlerini kapsasın. Bash, web, alt ajan, MCP ve çalışma dizini dışına yazma yasak kalacak. Dry-run atlanmayacak. Bana çalıştıracağım exact komutu ver. Sonucu sana geri vereceğim. Ardından regression → Codex review → reseal → yeni ZIP sırasıyla devam et. [After the dry run] Dry-run kanıtını doğrula ve planlanan sırayla devam et: regression → reseal → commit → Codex independent review → new release ZIP. Yeni ZIP üretildiğinde önceki ZIP/signature artık geçersiz kabul edilsin ve yeni artifact yeniden imzaya gönderilsin. [PKG-R] reseal yetkisi: bu paket içinde maintainer-only generate-trust-root.mjs final reseal'ini çalıştırma yetkisi.
founderAuthorization.constraint: Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; UNKNOWN, NOT_TESTED, BLOCKED or FAIL are never converted to PASS/CLEAN without real evidence; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.

phase0Attempt1.signature: Founder OpenSSH ed25519 SHA256:MfkZmrCjx1C+fg6n5YX1bxbYKwcu85/APcueHtefFw8, verified with the public key
phase0Attempt1.result: FAIL at bootstrap-core: canonical validation step runtime-contracts (PHASE0_INSTALL_ID_ENV_LEDGER_MISMATCH); install-report.mjs crashed (crypto.createHash is not a function); nothing pushed, remote repository still empty
phase0Attempt1.superseded: the f0a4f0a ZIP and its signature are superseded by this release candidate

PHASE0-F1.cause: install.ps1 exports UASCO_INSTALL_ID; the validate-runtime-contracts.mjs temp fixture has its own INSTALL_STEPS ledger (INSTALL-2G), so collectPhase0Binding threw PHASE0_INSTALL_ID_ENV_LEDGER_MISMATCH and runtime-contracts plus paste2-source-closure always failed inside the installer
PHASE0-F1.fix: the fixture saves, removes and finally restores the host UASCO_INSTALL_ID; a new check sets a foreign id and asserts PHASE0_INSTALL_ID_ENV_LEDGER_MISMATCH is still thrown; automation/lib/phase0-contract.mjs is unchanged

PHASE0-F2.cause: scripts/install-report.mjs used the global WebCrypto object without importing node:crypto, so INSTALL_REPORT.json was never written

PHASE0-F3.cause: config/builder-execution-policy.json permissionMode dontAsk denied the Write tool (Claude: The Write tool was denied), so builder-boundary-smoke reported insideEdit=false and the builder could not edit the repository at all
PHASE0-F3.fix: permissionMode acceptEdits; allowedTools stay exactly Read, Edit, Write, Glob, Grep via --tools; disallowedTools Bash, WebFetch, WebSearch, NotebookEdit, Agent, Skill and mcp__* unchanged; the broker default stays dontAsk when the field is missing
PHASE0-F3.boundaryEvidence: scratch builder-boundary-smoke PASS 2/2 by Claude and PASS in the Founder-run dry run; direct probe: reading a file outside the working directory was refused by the tool permission and an append to it did not happen
PHASE0-F3.history: V2 P0-01 flagged acceptEdits with an unrestricted tool set; the --tools restriction and disallowed tools now close that gap
